mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( email, nickname, profile_image_path, role, password, email_verified, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at ) VALUES ( #{email}, #{profile.nickname}, #{profile.imagePath}, #{role}, #{password}, #{emailVerified}, NOW(), NOW(), NULL )
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET email = #{email}, nickname = #{profile.nickname}, profile_image_path = #{profile.imagePath}, role = #{role}, password = #{password}, email_verified = #{emailVerified}, updated_at = NOW(), deleted_at = #{deletedAt} WHERE user_id = #{id}
